siteTitle: SV Creations | Architects, Construction & Interior Design
siteDescription: SV Creations designs and builds homes end to end: architectural design, civil plans, house construction and complete interiors under one roof.

hero.title: We design, plan and build your home, end to end.
hero.subtitle: From the first sketch and civil plan to construction and finished interiors, SV Creations takes care of everything under one roof.

homepageText: Building a home shouldn't mean juggling an architect, a contractor and an interior designer separately. At SV Creations, one team carries your project from concept to keys: architectural drawings and civil plans, quality construction, and interiors designed to be lived in. You get a single point of contact, transparent costs and a home that matches the plan you approved.

about.title: About SV Creations
about.text:
SV Creations is an architecture, construction and interior design studio that delivers homes end to end. We prepare complete civil plans (floor plans, elevations, structural and working drawings), manage construction on site, and finish with interiors tailored to how you live.

Every project starts with listening: your plot, your budget, your family's routines. From there we design practical, light-filled homes and build them with materials and workmanship we stand behind. Whether you need just a plan and elevation for your site, or a complete turnkey home, we'd love to build it with you.

services.title: Architectural Design & Civil Plans
services.description: Complete drawing sets for your plot: floor plans, elevations, 3D views, structural and working drawings, plus plans ready for municipal approval.
services.price: Priced per sq.ft of built-up area

services.title: House Construction
services.description: End-to-end turnkey construction from foundation to finishing, with quality materials, experienced workmanship and clear stage-wise billing.

services.title: Interior Design
services.description: Complete home interiors: modular kitchens, wardrobes, false ceilings, TV units, lighting and furnishing, designed and executed by our own team.

services.title: Renovation & Elevation Makeovers
services.description: Give an existing home a new face: modern elevations, layout changes, extensions and interior refurbishment, handled with minimal disruption.

process.title: Consultation & Site Visit
process.description: We understand your requirements, visit your plot and discuss budget, timelines and approvals.

process.title: Design & Civil Plans
process.description: Floor plans, elevations and 3D views are drafted and refined with you until every detail is approved.

process.title: Construction
process.description: Our team builds to the approved drawings with quality materials, stage-wise updates and site supervision.

process.title: Interiors & Handover
process.description: Kitchens, wardrobes, ceilings and finishes are completed, and your home is handed over ready to live in.

pricingText: Every plot and every family is different, so we quote per project. Share your plot size, location and what you have in mind, and we'll visit the site to give you a clear, itemised estimate with no hidden costs.

testimonials.name: Ramesh & Lakshmi
testimonials.text: From the first plan to the day we got our keys, everything was handled by one team. The house came out exactly like the 3D design they showed us.

testimonials.name: Srinivas K
testimonials.text: Very practical floor plan that used every square foot of our small plot. Approval drawings were done quickly and the elevation gets compliments from everyone.

testimonials.name: Anitha Reddy
testimonials.text: The modular kitchen and wardrobes are beautifully finished. They suggested ideas within our budget instead of pushing expensive options.
